Name: Mit Recap
Author: Vali
Punchline: See when your tanks and healers pressed their mitigations and heals.
Description: Records every mitigation and heal your party uses during a duty. Right-click a party member in a duty and pick Mit Recap, or type /mitrecap, to see what they pressed and when, pull by pull. Looks and reads like Death Recap, but covers the whole duty and not only deaths.
